notes: Two articles standing on suffixed nouns go unrepresented because the ASV writes one determiner apiece and the suffix takes it (rule 41).
The article on ba-yyom is unrepresented and the demonstrative ha-hu takes the single that, since a morpheme that is itself what the determiner says takes it (rules 30, 41).
qodesh takes the supplied as and a as an adverbial accusative (rule 33), with thing the supplied generic and the head on holy (rule 31).
